general: Implement the 'Tactical Industrial' theme. This means sharp lines, high contrast, and a focus on data density.
Use the 'Bento Grid' layout for the main dashboard. Avoid equal-sized cards; mix spans to create visual interest.
The Sidebar should be DARK (#0B1120) to contrast with the LIGHT (#F8F9FA) main content area.
Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all Headings (h1-h3) to give it that strong, vertical industrial look.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for any ID numbers, Order #s, or Status Codes.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.

login.layout: Split screen. Left side: Login form (White bg). Right side: Full height image (Warehouse/Industrial) with a Navy Blue overlay (opacity 80%).
login.elements: Logo prominent at top of form. 'Sign In to Portal' heading in Barlow Condensed.

dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (fixed left). Top header (white, sticky). Main content (gray bg, bento grid).
widgets: KPI Cards (Total Work Orders, Active Alerts, etc.) - Top row.
Recent Activity Feed (Vertical list) - Right column.
Quick Actions (Create WO, Add Asset) - Bottom or Sidebar.

work_orders.layout: Table view with advanced filters. Use Shadcn Table.
work_orders.details: Slide-over panel or separate page with 'Technical Spec Sheet' styling (borders, mono fonts for data).

components.charts: Use Recharts. Style them minimal. No grid lines inside charts if possible, or very subtle. Colors: Navy for primary data, Red for alerts.
components.tables: Dense rows. 'border-b' only. Header row uppercase and bold (Barlow Condensed).

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable inside containers, but keep the grid gaps tight (gap-4 or gap-6) for density.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
